items.t: A 70-Year-Old With $750,000 in Edison International, Realty Income and Northwest Bancshares Collects $3,417 a Month in Dividends. How Safe Is Each Check?
items.sum: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $750,000 portfolio split evenly across Edison International, Realty Income and Northwest Bancshares pays about $41,000 a year in dividends, or $3,473 a month. Each company covered its dividend in fiscal 2025 on its own measure: Edison paid out 51% of normalized EPS, Realty Income 75% of AFFO and Northwest 63% of normalized EPS.

items.t: A $400,000 Portfolio in Albertsons Companies, Edison International and Realty Income Pays $21,624 a Year in Dividends. Here’s What Happens if One Cuts
items.sum: Key TakeawaysA hypothetical $400,000 portfolio split evenly across Albertsons Companies, Edison International and Realty Income pays about $21,600 a year in dividends, or about $1,800 a month. Realty Income’s dividend has the least room on its own measure, at 75% of AFFO, but that’s near the low end of its history, and it raised the dividend again in November.
